audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer chart (phases[N].side) reads Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Syndra/Skill/Syndra while the content chart (win[N]) reads Syndra/Syndra/Syndra/Syndra/Neeko/Syndra/Neeko. They disagree on six of seven rows, and on rows 4 and 6 they name opposite champions.
audit.why: packet.levelChart = [Syndra, Syndra, Syndra, Syndra, Neeko, Syndra, Neeko], identical to the content layer. The content whys argue that verdict throughout (whys[4]: Pop Blossom is your window; whys[6]: your AoE outscales her single-target burst). The full layer is stale, and its whys still describe Neeko winning rows that belong to Syndra.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side -> Syndra, phases[4].side -> Neeko, phases[5].side -> Syndra, phases[6].side -> Neeko, with phases[0/1/2/3/5].why rewritten in the same proposal to argue Syndra's side. Rows 4 and 6 already had Neeko-favourable whys.

audit.why: Syndra owns 1-5 on sphere poke and Lost Chapter, level 6 flips to Neeko because the Pop Blossom wind-up is hidden while disguised, her first item re-takes the lead, and two items flip back to Neeko's AoE. spikes[0..3] carry this correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive numbers are absent and one line is a fabricated advantage. Both Q's are 800 range, so 'her Q out-ranges your Blooming Burst' is false — her edge is that Dark Sphere is ground-placed for 40 mana on a 7s flat cooldown while Neeko's seed has to hit. Scatter the Weak is 15s at EVERY rank and is the single window this lane runs on. Force of Will throws at 925 range and, upgraded by Transcendent, deals true damage. Unleashed Power executes at 675 range.
audit.why: enemyKit: Q 800 range / 7s flat / 40-60 mana; W 925 range, flagged trueDamage; E 650 range, 15s at all ranks; R 675 range, flagged execute. ownerKit Q is also 800 range, E is 1000 range / 12s, R preparation is hidden while disguised.
audit.corrected: Named the flat 15s E as the lane's clock, the flat 7s Q as why poke exchanges lose, the hidden Pop Blossom wind-up as the level-6 flip, and the true-damage W as why armour and raw MR are the wrong purchase.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' and breakdown.cooldowns confirms it — not one digit in the field.
audit.why: Defect-catalogue item 3. The kit supplies E 15s flat, Q 7s flat, W 12/11/10/9/8, R 120/100/80 against Neeko's 12s E.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rebuilt around the flat 15s E, the 7s Q re-arm versus your 12s E, and a concrete 'step up only after her E is spent' sequencing line.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text tells the reader to buy 'MR/Seeker's early' and wants.you[2] says 'Build MR'. Seeker's Armguard is an ARMOUR item and Syndra deals no physical damage, so it is dead gold here; and Force of Will upgraded by Transcendent is true damage that MR does not reduce at all.
audit.why: enemyKit W and P both carry the trueDamage flag; missingInteractions rule 'resistances-invalidated' names exactly Transcendent (P) and Force of Will (W).
audit.corrected: Both now point at Banshee's Veil — a spell block answers a combo that opens with a single stun — instead of stacking resistances against partly-true damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Syndra is female and the full layer addresses her as male throughout: ahead ('cost him plates'), tradeGood ('E his step-up'), breakdown.early ('every clone he answers wrong'), breakdown.wave ('near his tower'), dosFull[0].t ('Bloom his last-hit contact'), dontsFull[2].t and report[11].t ('during his key-spell window'). Separately, dosFull[1].d is the tradeGood string pasted under a clone title and dontsFull[2].d is the tradeBad string — copy-paste bleed.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists syndra as female; defect-catalogue items 1 and 2.
audit.corrected: Every misgendered field rewritten or corrected, and both bled bullets replaced with bodies that match their own titles.

notes: CHART: content win[0..6] already matches packet.levelChart exactly, so only the stale full-layer sides were moved; no no-op win[N] edits were proposed.
